mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as improved labor market conditions boost corporate investment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs, or the unemployment rate does not fall below 5.5% within the specified timeframe.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signals tightening labor market and higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the interaction of rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE, or the proxies do not exhibit the expected simultaneous trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply-side activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as companies expand output and investor sentiment strengthens.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show a sustained upward trend for 3 months, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher inflation and adjust portfolios toward safer assets.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs, or the FEDFUNDS rate does not cross above 4.0% within the specified timeframe.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of falling unemployment (UNRATE) and rising personal consumption (GDPC1) signals labor market strength and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of falling UNRATE and rising GDPC1 does not occur, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as investors anticipate prolonged growth and lower interest rates.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite a decline in FEDFUNDS, or the decline does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust demand and supply, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as market optimism intensifies.
failure_condition: The proxies do not exhibit a sustained upward trend together, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
